name: LeanPolish: A Kernel-Verified Dataset and Symbolic Compression Framework for Lean 4 Proofs
description: Kernel-verified Lean 4 proof rewrite pairs with goal states, deduplicated contrastive rejected siblings, and full provenance. The release contains 33,402 accepted training pairs and 65,596 rejected siblings generated by LeanPolish on Mathlib4 v4.21.0, Goedel-Workbook, miniF2F, PutnamBench-derived proof pools, and Putnam 2025 / AxiomProver. Hugging Face loads byte-equivalent Parquet mirrors under parquet/; canonical JSONL shards and SHA-256 provenance are pinned in shards/MANIFEST.json.
citeAs: Anonymous. LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset is generated automatically by running the LeanPolish proof-shortening pipeline over public Lean 4 theorem-proving corpora. Accepted rows are emitted only after Lean kernel checking and out-of-process file re-elaboration. Rejected rows are failed or lower-ranked sibling candidates retained for contrastive learning and auditability.
rai:dataCollectionType: Automated extraction and verification from public formal proof corpora; no human-subject data collection.
rai:dataProcessing: Rows are normalized to schema version 2, exact duplicate rejected siblings are removed, paths and provenance are normalized, and Parquet mirrors are produced for Hugging Face viewing. Canonical JSONL shard hashes and provenance remain in shards/MANIFEST.json.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal data, human-subject data, or intentionally collected sensitive attributes are included. Source corpora are public Lean code/proof corpora.
rai:annotation: No manual annotation of people or sensitive attributes is used. Labels such as accepted/rejected are produced by LeanPolish verification and scheduler outcomes.
rai:intendedUse: Research on Lean 4 proof compression, tactic selection, symbolic proof optimization, preference modeling, DPO/RL training, and reproducibility audits of verified proof rewrites.
rai:limitations: Rows are limited to the selected public Lean corpora, Lean 4.21.0/Mathlib v4.21.0, and LeanPolish candidate generation. Accepted rows are verified Lean edits but are not guaranteed to be globally minimal or stylistically preferred in every downstream context. Rejected rows are contrastive negatives, not mathematical counterexamples.
rai:risks: Models trained on this dataset may learn corpus-specific proof style, overfit to Mathlib/benchmark idioms, or propose tactics that still require Lean verification. Downstream users should keep kernel/file verification in the loop for generated proof edits.
rai:biases: Coverage reflects the distribution of the source theorem-proving corpora and the LeanPolish candidate generator, including stronger representation of Mathlib and generated benchmark proofs than informal mathematics or underrepresented Lean domains.
rai:maintenance: Version 1.0.0 is a static release. Future schema-incompatible releases will bump schema_version and update shards/MANIFEST.json, README, and Croissant metadata.

distribution.description: Canonical manifest for the JSONL shard release, including per-file row counts, byte sizes, SHA-256 hashes, Lean toolchain, Mathlib revision, optimizer build commit, corpus URLs, licenses, and build timestamps.

rai:dataLimitations: Rows are limited to the selected public Lean corpora, Lean 4.21.0/Mathlib v4.21.0, and LeanPolish candidate generation. Accepted rows are verified Lean edits but are not guaranteed to be globally minimal or stylistically preferred in every downstream context. Rejected rows are contrastive negatives, not mathematical counterexamples.
rai:dataBiases: Coverage reflects the distribution of the source theorem-proving corpora and the LeanPolish candidate generator, including stronger representation of Mathlib and generated benchmark proofs than informal mathematics or underrepresented Lean domains.
rai:dataUseCases: Research on Lean 4 proof compression, tactic selection, symbolic proof optimization, preference modeling, DPO/RL training, and reproducibility audits of verified proof rewrites.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to support research on verified Lean proof tooling, proof-assistant automation, and reproducible evaluation of proof-compression methods. It may reduce manual proof-maintenance effort when used with Lean kernel verification in the loop, but generated edits should not be trusted without verification.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.prov:label: PutnamBench Lean4 subset and kernel-verified subset

prov:wasGeneratedBy.prov:label: Source corpus collection
prov:wasGeneratedBy.sc:description: LeanPolish was run over public Lean 4 proof corpora and benchmark repositories: Mathlib4 v4.21.0, Goedel-LM Lean Workbook proofs, miniF2F, PutnamBench, and Putnam 2025 / AxiomProver candidate proofs. Source URLs and licenses are listed in prov:wasDerivedFrom and in shards/MANIFEST.json.

prov:wasAttributedTo.prov:label: Anonymous LeanPolish authors
prov:wasAttributedTo.sc:description: Anonymous authors. No crowdworkers or human-subject annotators were used.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.prov:label: LeanPolish candidate generation
